card.name: Start of a longer word being spelled out
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer word that is split up, such as AV in AVAILABILITY, M in MATE1, Sus in Susceptibility, or tr in trivial. It also fires on a few small words like 's or the before a noun.

modes.label: Opening piece of split word
modes.description: The first piece of a word broken into several parts, often in capitals or in transporter names.
modes.example: ENSURING THE IMMEDIATE<< AV>>AILABILITY OF OXYGEN, OTHER

modes.label: Transporter name start
modes.description: The letter M that begins MATE1 in lists of transporter substrates.

modes.label: Small word in running text
modes.description: A short word such as 's or the that is followed by a noun in ordinary prose.
modes.example: In the past century<< the>> Church has grown both extensively and intensively

card.writes: It promotes word-start pieces such as ver, spect and pend, which suggests it prepares the next piece of a word.
card.plain: It fires when a long word has only just begun and the rest of the word is still to come.
